name: Give Me Bait
overview:
Before the age of eighteen, Song Xia Zhi lived as a cherished young girl. On her birthday, however, a car accident took the lives of her parents. She was then adopted by the Shen family, who gradually took control of her family assets. The only thing left to her was an inheritance her mother had arranged as a future dowry, sealed in an overseas bank. The key to the safety deposit box was later tricked away by Qian Mei.

For the benefit of the Shen family, Shen Du arranges for Song Xia Zhi to marry into the Tan family. Everyone believes that Tan Huai Feng is taking a concubine, but in reality, he is selecting a marriage partner on behalf of Tan Si Diao.

(Source: Chinese = 红果短剧 app || Translation = MyDramaList)
